=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Before resuming a previously filed fix-up, recognize a still-blocked issue with a trusted automation-path rejection and a prior descope or operator_step verdict. Record the operator handoff and hold marker instead of clearing the block or posting a resume command."
  expected_change_site: merged-fix-up arm of `scripts/unblock_judge.sh`, with the default configured in `.github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml`
  confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The new handoff branch is only active when UNBLOCK_PROTECTED_HANDOFF_ENABLED is set to true. The workflow file (.github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml:157) and the script (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:692) both default this to false, The LAST RUN DIFF branches the fix-up-merged path on `unblock_protected_handoff_applies`, which returns true only when `UNBLOCK_PROTECTED_HANDOFF_ENABLED=true` (`scripts/unblock_judge.sh:689-692`). The workflow default at `.github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml:157` and the helper default (`UNBLOCK_PROTECTED_HANDOFF_ENABLED:-false`) keep the new branch inactive. With the default configuration, the merged-fixup arm falls through to the existing `followup` resume at `scripts/unblock_judge.sh:920-929`, exactly the activation gap the issue asks to close.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh: merged-fix-up arm, `if unblock_try_regrant; then unblock_patch_comment "${wait_id}" ... done ...; unblock_log ... outcome=followup_regrant; return 0` (about lines 883-891), together with `unblock_try_regrant` lines 531-537 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `unblock_try_regrant` returns 0 both when it regranted and when it failed, so the new branch treats every 0 as a successful regrant, marks the fix-up wait `done`, and logs `outcome=followup_regrant`.
  WHY: If the resume command or label write fails after the marker, the wait is marked done and the failure is hidden; the next run sees `already_regranted`, so the issue is not resumed and the fix-up merge is never retried.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py: `_protected_handoff_ops` body (lines 541-543) and WARNING text (line 576), reused unchanged by `followup_handoff_ops` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The hold comment says "A fix-up issue would hit the same guard, so none was created." and the WARNING says "no fix-up created", although a fix-up was created and has already merged.
  WHY: The person picking up the operator handoff is told no fix-up exists, and the `Change:` line is a fixed generic string instead of the original verdict's instructions.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/unblock_actions.py: _protected_handoff_ops function, line 576 (body string) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The warning message returned by _protected_handoff_ops incorrectly states "no fix-up created".
  WHY: This function is called by followup_handoff_ops, which runs after a fix-up issue has already merged, so the warning is misleading to the operator receiving it.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh: unblock_main function, lines 885-890 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The logic assumes a zero exit from unblock_try_regrant indicates a fully successful regrant, including the underlying reset operations.
  WHY: If unblock_try_regrant posts the regrant marker but subsequent reset operations fail, the script marks the fix-up wait done and logs followup_regrant; subsequent checks can reject the run as already_regranted, potentially leaving the item stalled.
Requirement: Before resuming a previously filed fix-up, recognize a still-blocked issue with a trusted automation-path rejection and a prior descope or operator_step verdict. Record the operator handoff and hold marker instead of clearing the block or posting a resume command.
Expected change site: .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml and scripts/unblock_judge.sh
Evidence of absence: The new handoff branch is only active when UNBLOCK_PROTECTED_HANDOFF_ENABLED is set to true. The workflow file (.github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml:157) and the script (scripts/unblock_judge.sh:692) both default this to false. With default settings, the system continues to resume merged fix-ups straight into the guard that blocked them, which does not fulfill the requirement's intent.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
